topography.project_purpose: Gearbox is an on-chain credit and lending protocol built around smart contract credit accounts. Its current positioning emphasizes a tokenisation lending stack and compliant credit infrastructure for tokenized and RWA assets, including segregated accounts, margin, prime brokerage-style credit, and portfolio loans, while retaining DeFi lending and composability as part of the underlying architecture.
topography.relationship_narrative: Lending Pools supply liquidity to Credit Managers, which use Price Feeds for collateral valuation and risk assessment. Core Contracts provide shared registry, access control, and staking infrastructure used across all families.
